description: Serve an app under the owner's own domain (Pro: three per account). 'attach' with a hostname (e.g. app.example.com) answers the DNS record the owner must add (CNAME to clients.dropyour.site) and the state 'en_attente'; the domain serves once the DNS points to Dropyour and the certificate is issued ('actif'). 'status' re-checks it; 'detach' removes it. Needs a connected account.
name: dropyour_domain
title: Custom domain of an app
